Thanks for the update on the purchasing queue — totally understand how these reviews can stall (legal + finance). To make sure the work your team has done with the prototype doesn't lose momentum, we'd like to offer a short, complimentary sandbox grant while your PO and legal approvals finish up.

Quick summary of the offer (no-obligation):

- Scope: Non-production sandbox only (isolated tenant, no export of logs)
- Limits: 50k token-equivalent credit, 3 seats, rate limits applied
- Security: access uses our temporary token system; SSO/SCIM not enabled for the grant
- Next steps: if you want this, reply with "ACCEPT" and confirm the email address to provision (we'll provision the same demo account by default).

I've attached a one-page terms stub (sandbox-grant-terms.pdf) — standard emergency demo-preservation terms. This is intended solely to preserve evaluation progress; it does not change procurement timelines or payment terms.

If you prefer a shorter or longer window, tell me and we'll do our best to accommodate.
